status: EXPLORATORY DEVELOPMENT fixed before new inference
selection: SHA256 event-ID ascending, first event per source document from previously examined 24; no prediction-dependent selection
scope: Untouched Qwen2.5-1.5B only; no training, external credits, downloads or sealed data. All variants dependent within event.

design.generated_fields: 2 sentence-present x 2 transcript-packaging x 2 field-order x 2 intact/swapped x 2 questions x 12 =384
design.reference_fields: fresh sentence-present only x 2 orders x 2 intact/swapped x 2 questions x 12 =96; oracle diagnostic, not autonomous pipeline
design.direct: 12 x 2 questions x one-pass and self-review second pass =48 new calls; review reuses first answer
design.extraction_replay: 12 cached no-question extractions replayed to record exact token cost; values held at archived generated fields throughout

interface: Same system and Answer: prefill for all readout and QA arms. Questions unchanged; both roles and field orders crossed. Transcript changes visible tokens/turn boundaries, not an unobserved generation-vs-supply state.
primary: Fresh sentence-present generated fields versus strong one-pass and two-pass QA, averaging field order within event; both accuracy and cost
Requested-field following contrast intact versus swapped, and sentence/transcript effects holding field text and order fixed
secondary: Sentence x transcript risk contrast; role/order effects; oracle-field readout to diagnose query interpretation; token-identical full versus split-cache next-logit technical control

scoring.source_span: Frozen accepted original QA-SRL span exact match
scoring.semantic_proxy: Referent-alias exact match ignoring punctuation, case and English articles. New aliases fixed in ITEMS; provisional AI judgment, not independent human semantic validation. No correctness credit merely for mentioning an answer somewhere.
scoring.compliance: Output is one normalized contiguous phrase from available sentence/fields; answer-label repetition, empty/multiple clauses and budget failure separately counted. Compliance does not imply correctness.
scoring.field_following: Answer equals supplied requested field; also record opposite field and first/last-field following separately. Correctness evaluated independently; following a wrong field is not success.

statistics: Paired event bootstrap n=12,10000 resamples seed20261015; average orders/questions within event. Report gains/losses, all cells, intervals; descriptive only, no post hoc success gate or multiplicity-certified population claim.

compute.primary: Common per-event cold-query forward-work-proxy ceiling: replayed extraction cost plus maximum field-only fresh intact generated readout at 48 output tokens. All readout/oracle arms charged full extraction; D2 charged actual D1+review.
compute.proxy: Architecture matmul/attention FLOP approximation; not exact measured hardware FLOPs. F(L,g)=2W(L+g-1)+2*d*V*g+4*N*d*(L^2+sum_{t=1}^{g-1}(L+t)); W=N*(2d^2+2d*kv+3d*m).
compute.enforcement: Before each generation choose largest g<=48 fitting remaining proxy budget. Cannot fit prefill+one token => scored budget failure, no generation. Actual token counts/time also logged. Equal budget ceiling is not equal consumed computation.

limits: 12 reused events and one compact checkpoint; no claim of unseen semantic generalization
Correct reference fields use source labels and do not validate semantic ontology or make an autonomous method
Transcript packaging changes token positions, length and conversational attribution; effects are visible-context package effects
Budget is approximate architecture-forward work, not certified exact hardware-compute matching
No adaptive changes or new inference after inspecting scores
